description: Create a one-time credit pack checkout for a human to pay in their browser. Show only checkout_url to the human; keep session_id and claim_token with the agent and never put claim_token in a browser URL. After payment, poll claim_purchase every 10–15 seconds for up to 15 minutes. The API key appears only in the claim_purchase tool result, once with a 15-minute same-IP retry grace window. To top up an existing account, authenticate this MCP connection with its Bearer or X-API-Key header before calling.
